build_eval_dataset: build a datasets Eval builder to load evaluation log files as a HuggingFace dataset
create_split_generators: create split generators from extracted data files and infer features from sample logs
iter_samples_from_log_files: iterate over sample JSON log files and serialize nested dicts and lists to strings
sort_samples_key: parse a sample file path to extract epoch and sample indices for sorting
generate_examples: generate keyed examples from evaluation log files for the HuggingFace datasets builder
